candidate_ideas.statement: Without a global splitting of the filtered CE bundle W, Fit_0(coker φ)=I_12(φ)=I_6(φ_5)=a_N^*I_e holds scheme-theoretically and compatibly with arbitrary locally Noetherian base change.
On a geometric balanced fibre, as D ranges through Sym^6(C_b), the evaluation map drops rank if and only if O(D)≅L_b=W_5⊗ω^{-1}; the geometric rank-drop set is exactly |L_b|, of dimension h^0(L_b)−1.
The ordered reduced-support fibre over |L_b| is a finite étale S_6-cover of the reduced-support open in |L_b| and is either empty or of dimension h^0(L_b)−1.

Under the standard CE-resolution and equation-bundle finite-local-freeness/base-change hypotheses, the ambient CE evaluation has the same cokernel and determinantal failure scheme as the intrinsic filtered evaluation.

The determinantal rank ideals and fibre-dimension statements for the filtered balanced CE evaluation at (6,6) can be obtained from filtered Fitting, Serre duality, and Clifford geometry with no finite computational artifact.

established_facts.evidence: Packet primary locator SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 and canonical geometric bottleneck degree calculation.
established_facts.statement: For the Casnati–Ekedahl line bundles on a smooth genus-6 curve, deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f, so deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_5⊗ω_C^{-1})=6.
On any smooth genus-6 balanced tetragonal cover, the f=5 CE obstruction line ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ) has degree 0 for every degree-six divisor Γ, so evaluation fails on Γ if and only if O_C(Γ)≅L:=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}.

The forgetful map from the relative ordered distinct configuration stack Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) to the relative effective-divisor space of degree six is a finite étale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open locus.

For L=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1} of degree 6 on a smooth genus-6 curve, χ(L)=1 proves only that the full Abel–Jacobi fibre in Sym^6 is nonempty; it does not prove that the reduced-support open, or the ordered Conf_6 incidence, is nonempty on every geometric fibre.

On every smooth genus-6 fibre of the balanced tetragonal CE family, M:=ω_C^2⊗W_5^∨ has degree 4 and is always special, so Clifford yields h^0(L)=1+h^0(M)∈{1,2,3,4} (never 5), with h^0(L)=4 exactly when C is hyperelliptic and M≅(g^1_2)^{⊗2}.

For a line bundle L of relative degree d on a smooth proper curve family C/B, relative effective divisors Γ with O(Γ)≅L are represented by the Abel–Jacobi fibre Sym^d(C/B)×_{Pic^d_{C/B}}B; this model is correct over all of B, while Proj(π_*L) matches only where h^0(L) is constant.

For the filtered balanced CE evaluation at (g,n)=(6,6) with six pairwise-disjoint sections, every geometric fibre has rank(φ)∈{11,12} and rank(φ_5)∈{5,6}, because the cokernel is Serre-dual to H^0 of a degree-zero line bundle; consequently the deeper minor ideals satisfy I_11(φ)=I_5(φ_5)=O_B as ideal sheaves on any locally Noetherian base.

established_facts.evidence: Visible arithmetic χ=deg−g+1: 20−6+1=15, 16−6+1=11; six sections give length-6 targets, and 15+11=26 with doubled target rank 12.
established_facts.statement: With fibre degrees deg W_4=20 and deg W_5=16 on a smooth genus-6 curve, Riemann–Roch gives χ(W_4)=15 and χ(W_5)=11; for six pairwise-disjoint sections the graded evaluation targets have rank 6 and the filtered rank-two evaluation has ranks 26→12.

established_facts.evidence: Dimension count 6−(h^0(L_b)−1)=7−h^0(L_b) recorded in the observable argument.
established_facts.statement: On a fixed smooth genus-6 fibre, dim Sym^6(C_b)=6, so if the geometric rank-drop set equals |L_b| of dimension h^0(L_b)−1 then its codimension in Sym^6(C_b) is 7−h^0(L_b).

unresolved_dependencies.statement: Nonemptiness of the reduced-support open in |L_b| and of the ordered Conf_6 incidence on every balanced geometric fibre.
